steps.title: Wipe
steps.caption: The tool loops over thousands of files and overwrites their content with junk bytes. A fake ransom note appears on screens, but there is no encryption key and no encryption events. Defenders see a write storm: extreme file-modification volume from one process, files rewritten at constant size
